1.footnotes: [1] i.e., those who cheat people by giving them less in sale transactions, an amount so little as to hardly be noticed.

2.translation: those who take full measure when they take from others,

3.translation: but they give less when they measure or weigh for them.

4.translation: Do they really not think that they will be resurrected

6.translation: a Day when people will stand before the Lord of the worlds?

7.translation: No indeed! The record of the wicked is surely in Sijjīn.

8.translation: How do you know what Sijjīn is?

9.translation: It is a clearly inscribed Record.

10.translation: Woe on that Day to the deniers,

11.translation: those who deny the Judgment Day!

12.translation: None denies it except every sinful transgressor.

13.translation: When Our verses are recited to him, he says, “Ancient fables[2]!”
13.footnotes: [2] i.e., tales of old times, legends of former peoples.

14.translation: No indeed! Their hearts have been stained by what they used to commit[3]!
14.footnotes: [3] i.e., their sins and evil deeds.

15.translation: No indeed! On that Day they will be barred from seeing their Lord[4].
15.footnotes: [4] As a punishment, since the believers will see Him.

16.translation: They will then surely enter the Blazing Fire,

17.translation: then they will be told, “This is what you used to deny.”

18.translation: No indeed! The record of the righteous is certainly in ‘illiyyīn –

19.translation: and how do you know what ‘illiyyūn is? –

21.translation: witnessed by those who are close to Allah.

22.translation: Indeed, the righteous will be in Bliss,

23.translation: seated on the couches, gazing in wonder.

24.translation: You will see on their faces the radiance of bliss.

25.translation: They will be served to drink pure wine from a sealed container,

26.translation: whose last sip is musk[5] – let those who strive, strive for that –

27.translation: and it will be mixed with water from the spring of Tasnīm[6],
27.footnotes: [6] It is the highest spring in Paradise.

28.translation: a spring from which those who are close to Allah will drink.

29.translation: Indeed, the wicked used to laugh at the believers;

30.translation: when they passed by them, they would wink at one another,

31.translation: and when they went back to their people, they would return exulting.

32.translation: When they saw the believers, they would say, “These people are truly misguided,”

33.translation: although they were not sent as their keepers.

34.translation: So Today[7] the believers will laugh at the disbelievers,

35.translation: while sitting on the couches, gazing around.

36.translation: Have the disbelievers been rewarded except for what they used to do?
